payload.content_markdown:
### Task Dispatch Loop

The central dispatch loop polls the prioritized task queue using multi-level feedback scheduling. Priority bands are partitioned into:

1. **Critical:** System health and heartbeat checks.
2. **High:** Real-time stream processing workflows.
3. **Default:** Standard batch analytical tasks.

Worker threads consume tasks from ring buffer slots without cross-thread lock contention.

records.title: ADR-001: Adopt Embedded SQLite with WAL for Job Persistence

payload.context: Aurora requires durable task persistence across process restarts without introducing complex external database infrastructure (such as Postgres or Redis) during local edge deployments.
payload.decision: Use embedded SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode enabled, PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL, and a 5-second busy timeout for concurrent multi-thread reads and writes.
payload.consequences: Single-file durability with zero external services. Reads never block writers and writers never block readers. SQLite FTS5 enables local instant searching across task logs.
payload.alternatives_considered:
1. In-memory hash map with periodic JSON dumping (risk of data loss).
2. External PostgreSQL container (violates zero-dependency requirement).

records.title: ADR-002: In-Memory Ring Buffer for Task Event Streaming

payload.context: High-throughput task state transitions produce up to 50,000 events/second. Writing every transient transition directly to disk creates I/O bottlenecks.
payload.decision: Buffer state transitions in a bounded, lock-free ring buffer before batch flushing to SQLite in transactional page chunks.
payload.consequences: Sub-millisecond event ingestion latency. Memory usage is strictly bounded by buffer capacity.
payload.alternatives_considered: Unbounded mpsc channels (risk of out-of-memory under backpressure).

payload.description: Stabilize core task dispatch loops, concurrency primitives, and crash recovery routines.
Introduce zero-telemetry local performance histograms and queue depth tracking.

records.title: Resolved worker thread starvation under heavy load

payload.summary: Fixed worker thread starvation under unbalanced priority queues.
payload.details: When high-priority queues experienced sustained spikes, default-priority workers starved. Implemented fair round-robin scheduling yielding CPU cycles after 5 consecutive high-priority executions.

payload.explanation: Executes full multi-worker integration test suite with live console tracing output.
